column3: “of one piece with it” renders “from it.”
“the pails” renders “the pots,” and “the flesh hooks” renders “the forks.”
NASB restructures the verse, supplying “and so” and rendering “from this side and from that side” as “On both sides.”
“the weaver” renders “a worker in colors (embroiderer),” and “the height” renders “the height in breadth.”
“This is the number of the things” renders “These are the accounts,” and “the command of Moses” renders “the mouth of Moses.”
NASB puts the explanation “that is, half a shekel …” in parentheses.
